raw_html: [[Alignment damage (weapon)#Anarchic|Anarchic]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alignment damage (weapon)#Anarchic|Anarchic]]:''' An anarchic weapon is chaotically aligned and infused with the power of chaos. It makes the weapon chaos-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all of [[lawful]] alignment.
